suites.title: accessibility.spec.ts
WR-8 The three shipped screens are accessible

specs.title: home, join lobby and meeting room pass axe and the fill probe in dark at all widths
home, join lobby and meeting room pass axe and the fill probe in light at all widths
the guest flow is reachable and operable by keyboard with focus shown by fill
motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion
a control fill lowered below 3:1 fails the audit

suites.title: headers.spec.ts
WR-3 Valid TLS and security headers at the public URL

specs.title: the desktop policy in tauri.conf.json is unchanged by the web policy
the same header assertions fail for HSTS on the bare static image

suites.title: hosting.spec.ts
WR-2 Deep links and reloads return the app

specs.title: the / route returns the app document and survives a reload
the /join route returns the app document and survives a reload
the /meet route returns the app document and survives a reload
the /history route returns the app document and survives a reload
the /recordings route returns the app document and survives a reload
a missing asset is a 404, not the app document

suites.title: meeting.spec.ts

specs.title: two guests see and hear each other, mute, and leave
a guest who presses browser Back is no longer shown in the meeting
